notes: Spec asserts: a live parent + in-flight subagent, then a SIGKILL on the shared OS process (muse's subagents run in-process and share the parent's PID), and both sessions eventually disappear without either ever spuriously transitioning to working/waiting during cleanup (issue #321 invariant). Muse's children share the parent's PID, which is the exact trigger shape of open bug #1962 (pidMonitor.watched map[int]string is last-write-wins per PID) — cited in this cell's metadata.json caveats, not re-derived here. #1962 only affects WHICH path (kqueue-fast vs PIDManager.CheckPIDLiveness's independent per-session ESRCH sweep, <=~15s worst case) reaps whichever session the kqueue race starves, not whether it eventually happens, so parent_killed and child_cleanup below carry a generous max_delay_ms rather than assuming near-simultaneous kqueue delivery for both. Session-birth shape (single-birth vs a transient proc-<PID> presession) follows 2-13_turn-end-terminal-text's live-confirmed pattern for muse: the real parent session is born directly into ready. LIVE CONFIRMATION of #1962 (record, 2026-09-14, attempt 2, session 01a0a132-282a-75c1-862c-cf2881a60f66, child 01a0a132-3a9d-7021-aed1-21f312cb17a9, confirmed the real delegated subagent via child_session_bound's subagent_id matching spawn_accepted's command_id:"sleep30-task"/role:"worker"/objective verbatim-matching the recipe, cross-checked against the parent's task_stream_linked entries -- only skill-reminder/scope-reminder role:reminder children ever appear there, none pointing at this child -- and zero reminder_decision/reminder-state hits in the child's own transcript): process_exited landed for the CHILD first via the kqueue NOTE_EXIT fast path (20:33:53.510) and for the PARENT only ~0.11s later via the redundant ESRCH sweep (20:33:53.620, reason:"pid exited (ESRCH)") -- exactly #1962's last-write-wins shape (the child's PID registration landed after the parent's, so the kqueue watch pointed at the child), self-healed almost immediately by the redundant sweep rather than the theoretical 15s worst case. SPEC CORRECTIONS (record, 2026-09-14): (1) Attempt 1 (session 01a0a12f-0abd-...) produced 0 children -- see metadata.json caveats for the recipe fix (removed an unseeded notes.txt dependency, raised pre-kill sleep 12->18s); this expected.jsonl reflects attempt 2's corrected recipe. (2) child_session_birth (kind:transcript_new) is REMOVED: attempt 2's real child session's FIRST daemon event was transcript_activity, not transcript_new (transcript_new never fired separately for this child, unlike every other muse child observed so far in this onboarding batch, e.g. 3-2/3-5's children) -- parent_linked is the reliable, always-observed proof of discovery+linkage (a session cannot be parent-linked without its transcript first being read), so child_linked is now the first child-side phase, anchored directly off parent_turn_start. (3) The four invariant strings on child_cleanup did not match either supported DSL form (`no <kind> for <noun>` requires no additional words after the kind name; `no state_transition to <state>` requires nothing after the state) -- "no state_transition to working for the parent after child_turn_start" matches NEITHER regex due to the trailing text, so all four were silently skipped as unknown-form (never actually checked). Corrected to the two literal supported forms (session-scoping is informational only in the current DSL per expected.go's own comment, so 'for the parent'/'for the child' are folded into one check each).
